title: U-Boot parks the panel-enable GPIO2_B4 low because the hybrid tree has no
blocker: `lvds@20038000` node for it to read; patch 0003 repairs that at the first modeset. Adding the node would hand over a lit panel and drop the dependency. Blocked: a device-tree change U-Boot itself reads; needs a resource flash and someone at the buttons if it does not come up.
